verdict: DoorDash grew revenue 33% to $4.0B on record order value of $31.6B, but profit attributable to shareholders slipped 5% to $184M as Deliveroo-era depreciation and a $48M restructuring bill weighed on the quarter.

segments.name: Marketplace services
segments.note: Fees from restaurants, stores and couriers on every order, plus DashPass subscriptions. DoorDash reports a single revenue stream; orders placed through it were worth $31.6B in the quarter.

opex.name: Sales & marketing
opex.note: Marketing and promotions to win diners, merchants and couriers.

opex.name: Research & development
opex.note: Building the delivery platform, including AI and autonomy work.

opex.name: General & administrative
opex.note: Running the company day to day.

opex.name: Depreciation & amortization
opex.note: Wear-and-tear on equipment, vehicles and software — the part not counted inside cost of revenue. It jumped with the Deliveroo acquisition.

opex.name: Restructuring charges
opex.note: One-off restructuring charges — exiting operations in certain countries.

takeaways.title: Record order value
takeaways.text: Marketplace GOV rose 37% to $31.6B on 933 million orders (+27%) — more people ordering more, across more categories than food.

takeaways.title: Revenue kept pace
takeaways.text: Revenue rose 33% to $4.0B. DoorDash keeps a slice of every order as its fee, so revenue grows with the value of what is ordered.

takeaways.title: Profit dipped despite growth
takeaways.text: Net income attributable to shareholders fell 5% to $184M: depreciation jumped to $269M after the Deliveroo deal and restructuring cost $48M — even though Adjusted EBITDA rose 28% to $754M.

oneTimers: The chart's net profit is $183M — net income including redeemable non-controlling interests. After a $1M loss attributable to those interests, $184M was attributable to DoorDash common stockholders, the headline figure.
Restructuring charges were $48M in the quarter — employee termination and closure costs as DoorDash exited operations in certain countries.
otherDetail: Interest income, net, of $34M, plus $6M of other income — $40M added to profit.
